name: Diamond*
artist: Custom character based on user-provided likeness
model: Built-in OpenAI image generation; deterministic game-frame export
notes: Eight-colour GBA pixel track. Single forward dread, tied-back locs, double-rim cup in rear hand, star pendant, piercings, rings, red scarf, sagging ripped denim and red sneakers. Original game timing retained. Frame 021 (power-punch recovery) reuses the 015 extended-jab drawing; the generated 021 had a sheared torso (kept in _replaced/).

tuning._readme: Diamond*'s world. Merged over the game's tuning when ?skin=diamond-star is used. Song titles / ad-libs go in theme + text once supplied.
